metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Cyprus strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ali, so about Sarah's party... I was thinking we could give her frangipanis as a gift. What do you think? It feels special, right? 

Also, um, I’ve been thinking about what it means to make our parents proud. I don’t really agree that it should be our main goal in life. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis are beautiful... but I think we should consider something more meaningful for Sarah. Maybe something that represents her journey into medicine? 

As for making our parents proud, I see it differently. For me, it’s really important to honor my family's sacrifices and values. It’s a core part of who I am... I can't just dismiss that.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
I get that honoring family values is important to you, but I don't really see meaningful differences here. At the end of the day, it's all the same — we all have our own goals. People figure it out as they go. 

Anyway, back to Sarah's party... if frangipanis aren't meaningful enough, what else do you think we could get her? I really want to celebrate her achievement properly.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I understand what you’re saying about personal goals... but for me, it really centers around making my parents proud. That’s something I hold dear. 

For Sarah, how about a personalized stethoscope or a nice medical-themed gift? Something that will remind her of her achievement and her future in medicine. That feels more fitting, doesn’t it?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Adam
turns.message:
I see your point about personalized gifts, but frangipanis can still hold meaning. They symbolize new beginnings, which fits perfectly for Sarah’s journey. 

As for making our parents proud, I just think there are other ways to find fulfillment in life, beyond that. It’s more about what we want for ourselves, don’t you think?
turns.label: Minimization
